text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Match 4 of the Aoharu Cup
Pre-Season has finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Apparently, one of today's opponents
is an undefeated team.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: If she's undefeated, that must mean she's incredibly strong, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice has to work
even harder than usual...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Ehehe, I'm nervous, but
maybe I'm starting to feel just a tiny bit excited...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... when the opposing team is strong, it just makes winning that much more rewarding.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone and Rice worked so hard,
and we've become super, super strong.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So... I'm sure everything will be fine.
As long as I can properly show the results of my training,
the outcome should follow...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's stay sharp and focused!
Yeah, let's stay focused and keep our guards up!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'll do a proper job!
